subject: reasoning
question:
Select the Venn diagram that best illustrates the relationship among the following classes. 

Women, Employed, Mothers
solution:
Venn diagram according to the given information is:

Women, Employed, Mothers 

 
• All mothers are women.
 
• Some of the mother can be employed and some of the women also can be employed.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69707574370ad0bd1699fce5bc58c3c143401ba9eed0bf772438e5cbe667f991.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 3".**
